Close-out · area o1-C · 2026-11-27T22:56Z

Delivered by PR #38051 (merged 1f1b1fe47f at 2026-11-27T22:56Z). On Turso, a build fences its writes to the generation it began: a write, listing or completion into a generation `dropSource` already removed ends the build with `LOCK_CONFLICT` 409 and opens nothing, matching pgvector. Noted, not owed (L1 7229415357): two generations with the same number, fingerprint and millisecond are indistinguishable (not reachable in practice); two builds of one source in one process share one mark. Nothing remains on this card; `pm:dispatched` removed with this comment.
